newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 11,200 slaughter steers and 4,500 heifers; 85,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 60 loads or 2,000 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,600 formulated and 1,900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00.
